Metadata.titleDefault: Maison Aurèle — Fine Jewellery, Montréal & Paris
Metadata.description: Contemporary fine jewellery made in our Old Montréal atelier. Stones traced from mine to setting, certified recycled gold. Private salon in Paris, by appointment.

Footer.intro: Contemporary fine jewellery, drawn and made by hand in our Old Montréal atelier since 2011.
Footer.montrealHours: Tuesday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Footer.commitments: Certified recycled gold · Stones traced from mine to setting

Home.heroLede: Since 2011, our Old Montréal atelier has shaped pieces that hold the light — and give it back at the slightest gesture.
Home.manifestoTitle: A stone has no brilliance of its own.
Home.manifesto1: It receives the light, bends it, breaks it apart, then returns it transformed. Our entire craft lives in that instant.
Home.manifesto2: Every piece is drawn around that gesture: the angle of a prong, the height of a setting, the weight of a band. Nothing is ornamental; everything serves the light.
Home.manifesto3: Our stones are traced from mine to setting, and our gold is recycled and certified. Beauty whose origins are known is worn more lightly.
Home.collectionsTitle: Three ways of holding the light.
Home.appointmentText: In Montréal, in Paris or from afar, an hour that is entirely yours: to try on, to understand a stone, to imagine a commission. Never any obligation.
Home.tiltPrompt: Tilt to play with the light
Home.heroAlt: Aube Première ring in white gold: a 1.02-carat diamond on six fine prongs, turning slowly in the light.
Home.craftText: From the first pencil line to the last pass of the silk brush, every piece goes through six stages and as many hands, without ever leaving our Montréal atelier.
Home.craftCta: Follow the making of a ring

Craft.metaTitle: Craftsmanship: six stages, from sketch to polish
Craft.metaDescription: Sketch, gouache, wax, casting, setting, polishing: the making of a Maison Aurèle ring, stage by stage, in our Old Montréal atelier.
Craft.title: Six gestures, one light.
Craft.lede: A Maison ring takes an average of one hundred and twenty hours of work. Here, stage by stage, is how a pencil line becomes a stone that holds the light.
Craft.handsText: Modellers, casters, setters, polishers: each signs their stage in the piece’s register. Their names appear on the provenance record you receive with it.
Craft.closingText: Compose your ring in L’Atelier, or come and see the workbench up close: our Montréal and Paris salons welcome you by appointment.

House.metaTitle: The Maison: history, founder and commitments
House.metaDescription: Founded in 2011 on rue Saint-Paul by Hélène Aurèle, Maison Aurèle handcrafts contemporary fine jewellery with traced stones and recycled gold.
House.title: A light born on rue Saint-Paul.
House.lede: Since 2011, in a former warehouse in Old Montréal, fourteen artisans have worked a single material: light, and the way a stone holds it.
House.closingText: The atelier on rue Saint-Paul and the salon on rue de la Paix welcome you by appointment, to look at stones in daylight, with no obligation.

Provenance.metaTitle: Provenance: the journey of every stone
Provenance.metaDescription: From mine to atelier: find the origin, cutting, setting date and artisan of every Maison Aurèle piece with the code printed on its box.
Provenance.title: Every stone has an address.
Provenance.lede: We know where each of our principal stones comes from, where it was cut, on what day it was set and by whom. The code printed on your box opens that journey to you.

origin.title: Origin

SizeGuide.metaTitle: Ring size guide: measure on screen
SizeGuide.metaDescription: Find your ring size in two minutes: calibrate your screen with a bank card, place a ring, read its Canadian, French and British size.
SizeGuide.title: Your size, in two minutes.
SizeGuide.lede: A bank card and a ring that fits you: that is all you need. The card is the yardstick, because it is the same size all over the world.
SizeGuide.cardTitle: Hold a card against the screen.
SizeGuide.cardText: Place a bank, loyalty or ID card over the frame below, corner to corner, then adjust the frame until its edges exactly meet those of the card.
SizeGuide.cardTextPortrait: Hold a bank, loyalty or ID card upright over the frame below, then adjust the frame until its edges exactly meet those of the card.
SizeGuide.ringTitle: Place a ring on the circle.
SizeGuide.ringText: Choose a ring worn on the intended finger. Lay it flat on the screen and adjust the circle until it exactly follows the inner edge of the band.
SizeGuide.outOfRange: This measurement is outside our size range. Write to us: the atelier resizes beyond it.
SizeGuide.accuracy: Accurate to about half a size. Between two sizes, choose the larger. For an engagement ring, we will gladly send you a ring sizer, free of charge.
SizeGuide.tipsLede: A finger changes over the course of the day. A few precautions spare you a resizing.
SizeGuide.tip1: Measure at the end of the day, at room temperature: fingers are slimmer in the morning and in cold weather.
SizeGuide.tip2: If your knuckle is wider than the base of your finger, choose a size that slips over the knuckle without forcing.
SizeGuide.tip3: A wide band (over 4 mm) fits more snugly: go half a size up.
SizeGuide.tip4: For a surprise, discreetly borrow a ring worn on the same finger, or ask us for advice.
SizeGuide.tableCaption: Ring sizes in the three systems, with inner diameter and finger circumference.
SizeGuide.necklaceText: 40 cm sits at the base of the neck, 42 cm on the collarbone, 45 cm just below; 60 cm falls onto the chest. Every chain has an intermediate ring to shorten it by 2 cm.
SizeGuide.braceletText: Measure your wrist just above the bone with a soft tape, then add 1 cm for a close-fitting bracelet, 2 cm for one that moves freely.
